attacks.name: Spec Ops Rifle
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Suppressive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender loses 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Concussion Grenade
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
|!wild| |*Blinding Flash|: After the attack is resolved, the defender and enemy characters within |!range| 2 of it gain the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: The Red Agent
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Clean Sweep|: After this attack is resolved, deal 1 |!damage| to each other enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Kill Box
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends an Advance or is Placed within |!range| 4 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 3 or less and within |!range| 2 of the enemy character that was Advanced or Placed. Destroy that terrain feature. The enemy character suffers a collision as if the terrain feature had collided with it. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Spetsnaz Training
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die when either attacking or being attacked by a character that is within |!range| 1.
